description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the o_pop frequency, measured in units of 10^4, and two metrics of model performance: Initial Accuracy and Final Accuracy. The x-axis, labeled "o_pop frequency (x10^4)", spans a linear scale from 1 to 19, with tick marks at regular intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy", ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 in linear increments. The green line, representing Initial Accuracy, begins at approximately 0.35, rises to a peak of about 0.5 at o_pop frequency 5, dips to a low of approximately 0.3 at frequency 7, and then gradually increases to about 0.42 at frequency 19. The blue line, representing Final Accuracy, starts at approximately 0.65, rises to a peak of about 0.9 at frequency 9, dips to a low of approximately 0.65 at frequency 11, and then rises again to a peak of about 0.9 at frequency 15 before declining slightly to approximately 0.88 at frequency 19. Both lines are plotted with square markers and error bars indicating variability.
